jobs.occupation: Polish-Speaking babysitter / nanny in Sundbyberg – 2 afternoons per week
jobs.description:
Since 2008, Solidum Sverige AB / Barnakademin has helped families across Sweden find reliable, caring babysitters. We offer creative childcare in Swedish and specialize in bilingual babysitting, helping children develop their language skills naturally through play and everyday activities.
About the Position
We are looking for a caring, responsible, and enthusiastic Polish-speaking babysitter for a family in Sundbyberg, with two children aged 3 and 6.
The family needs regular help 2 afternoons per week, from 15:00 to 18:00 (6 hours per week). The role involves picking up the children from preschool/school, bringing them home safely, and spending the afternoon together until their parents return.
The family would like their children to maintain and develop their Polish language skills, so we are looking for someone who enjoys speaking Polish with children and making the language a natural part of everyday activities.
Your responsibilities will include:
Picking up the children from preschool/school and accompanying them home safely
Organizing fun, creative, and age-appropriate activities
Playing, reading, singing, and communicating with the children in Polish
Helping with simple afternoon routines and snacks
Creating a warm, safe, and positive environment for the children

Who We're Looking For
We would love to hear from you if you:
Speak Polish at a native or fluent level
Communicate confidently in English or Swedish
Have previous experience caring for children, professionally or privately
Are responsible, reliable, patient, and genuinely enjoy spending time with children
Enjoy creative play, outdoor activities, and engaging children in learning
Are available 2 weekdays per week, from 15:00 to 18:00
Can commit to the position until at least summer 2027

This position is particularly suitable for university students or anyone looking for a rewarding part-time job alongside their studies or other commitments.
What We Offer
A regular part-time position with a family in Sundbyberg
A supportive and friendly working environment
Ongoing guidance and support from our central office
A welcoming community of fellow babysitters
Written references at the end of your employment
Opportunities for additional babysitting assignments with other families
Valuable experience working with children in a bilingual environment

Available Only One Afternoon per Week?
We still encourage you to apply! Even if you cannot commit to both afternoons, we may have other families looking for Polish-speaking babysitters whose schedules match your availability.
Apply Today!
If you love working with children and would enjoy helping them grow up with the Polish language, we would be happy to hear from you!
Please submit your application in English or Swedish, including a brief description of your childcare experience, language skills, and availability.
We look forward to welcoming you to Barnakademin!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
About this vacancy

 

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) är en internationell skolmiljö där engagerade medarbetare arbetar tillsammans för att skapa trygghet, studiero och goda förutsättningar för lärande.

IES Värmdö är en F–9-skola med cirka 610 elever och 68 medarbetare. Skolan ligger i Charlottendal, Gustavsberg, med goda kommunikationer från Stockholm.

Vi söker nu en Student Care Coordinator (SCC) för ett vikariat på ett år, med möjlighet till förlängning. Tillträde är den 11 januari 2027.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som Student Care Coordinator arbetar du nära skolledning och elevhälsoteam för att främja elevernas trygghet, välbefinnande och utveckling. Du är en synlig och aktiv vuxen i skolmiljön och arbetar med elever från förskoleklass till årskurs 9.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

- Samordna, följa upp och dokumentera stödinsatser för elever.
- Arbeta förebyggande med trygghet, studiero, närvaro och socialt välbefinnande.
- Stödja elever med sociala, psykosociala och beteendemässiga behov.
- Samarbeta med elevhälsoteam, skolledning, lärare och vårdnadshavare.
- Bidra till skolans arbete mot kränkande behandling och genomföra informations- och utbildningsinsatser.
- Vara närvarande i skolans olika miljöer och bidra till en trygg och positiv skolvardag.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du har god förmåga att skapa förtroendefulla relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor och trivs i en internationell och föränderlig skolmiljö.

Vi ser att du har:

- God kunskap om skolans styrdokument och relevant skollagstiftning.
- Erfarenhet eller god kunskap om elevhälsoarbete och förebyggande insatser.
- Förståelse för arbetet med trygghet, studiero och kränkande behandling.
- God förmåga att samarbeta och kommunicera med elever, vårdnadshavare och externa aktörer.
- Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Vi erbjuder

- En internationell och stödjande arbetsmiljö.
- Engagerade kollegor och ett nära samarbete med skolledning och elevhälsa.
- Möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i elevernas vardag och skolgång.

Ansökan

Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev till recruitment.varmdo@engelska.se.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta maria.segerstedt.varmdo@engelska.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Science/Math Teacher year 6&8

Would you like to work in an international environment with a clear pedagogical policy?

We are now seeking a qualified and creative science & math  teacher for grades 6 & 8. Please note that we are a school with students from Year F-9. 

About you:You must be knowledgeable and passionate about your subject with a teacher qualification to teach science/math . You are a leader in the classroom with the tools to create a calm learning environment. You differentiate your teaching to meet the needs of all your students. Continuous formative feedback to students ensures the students steady development and is a natural part of your teaching.

As a teacher you are flexible and a dedicated team player, and have a passion for not only teaching your subject but also creating a relationship with your students and colleagues. As a mentor to 16 students you will support them to realise their full potential, whatever their background.

Great emphasis is placed on personal qualities.

About the job:The job description includes, besides regular teaching assignments like planning, teaching, grading and monitoring, also mentoring students in one of the classes you teach. You need to be available for meetings with guardians, students and colleagues and actively work to maintain IES values and vision. With us the focus lies on teaching and on a calm environment where the schools routines and rules are followed by both students and staff. A friendly atmosphere and a good collaboration  is the key behind our success. This is also the basis for creating a common thread that guides and supports our students through their schooling and helps them achieve their goals.

Apply now by submitting your resume and a covering letter via IES Careers. Recruitment is ongoing and the vacancy may be filled before the closing date, so please apply as soon as possible. We look forward to reading your application!

Vi önskar förstärka vårt SVA team och söker nu en legitimerad SVA lärare som kan undervisa nyanlända elever i årskurs 6-9.

- Samarbeta med kollegor inom SVA för att skapa en stödjande och inkluderande lärmiljö
- Planera, genomföra och utveckla lektioner
- Bedöma elevens framsteg, ge konstruktiv feedback och föra noggranna dokumentationer
- Mentorskap för elever i en av de klasserna du undervisar
- Delta i professionell utveckling och bidra till skolans gemenskap

- Du har lärarexamen med behörighet och legitimation i SVA
- Du kan uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
- Du planerar, genomför och utvärderar undervisningen samt arbetar för att skapa en trygg och stimulerande lärandemiljö.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och vi förutsätter att du har ett genuint intresse för barn och ungdomar. Tjänsten är 80%, visstid, fram till sommaren 2027. Lön enligt överenskommelse, kollektivavtal finns.

jobs.description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group ("friskola") with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is through both Swedish and English, with English the language of the corridors. IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at "Grundskolan" with 43 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993. IES Eskilstuna is one of the largest schools in Sweden with 1,185 students enrolled in grades F-9 and approx 125 staff members.
Vill du arbeta med barn och unga och göra skillnad i deras vardag? IES Eskilstuna söker engagerade och ansvarstagande timvikarier till vår grundskola för årskurs 4-9.Som timvikarie hos oss får du ett varierande och meningsfullt arbete där du stöttar verksamheten vid ordinarie personals frånvaro. Du möter elever i olika åldrar och blir en viktig del av skolans trygga och positiva lärmiljö.
Arbetsuppgifter:

Vikariera för lärare vid frånvaro

Ansvara för undervisning utifrån planering från ordinarie personal

Skapa trygghet, struktur och studiero i klassrummet

Bidra till en trygg och stimulerande lärmiljö under lektioner och raster

Samarbeta med kollegor

Vara behjälplig vid inom- och utomhusaktiviteter

Detta är en fantastisk möjlighet att få erfarenhet av att arbeta i en tvåspråkig miljö och utvecklas inom skolans värld! 
KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som är flexibel och kan hoppa in som timvikarie med kort varsel. Du har avslutad gymnasieutbildning och erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn och ungdomar. Det är meriterande om du tidigare arbetat på skola eller grundskola, studerar till fritidsledare/lärare i fritidshemmet eller har relevant utbildning inom området. 
Som person är du ansvarsfull och tycker om att ta egna initiativ. Du har ett tydligt elevfokus. Arbetet som timvikarie består av många möten och det är därför av stor vikt att du har en positiv människosyn och en god samarbetsförmåga. Framförallt har du ett brinnande intresse för barn och ungdomars lärande och utveckling.
Vi söker dig som:

Brinner för att arbeta med barn och ungdomar

Är trygg, flexibel och ansvarstagande

Har ett positivt bemötande och god samarbetsförmåga

Kan leda grupper och skapa god ordning

Kan skapa goda relationer med våra elever, personal och vårdnadshavare

Kan bidra till arbetsro i elevgrupp och i klassrummet

Har goda kunskaper i svenska och/eller engelska, både i tal och skrift

Anställningsformen är timanställning vid behov, med start så snart som möjligt.
För att arbeta hos oss krävs att du ska ha fyllt 18 år och du behöver ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret, ansök via länken.https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/ 
Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.
Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via email.
Välkommen med din ansökan!

CLEANING SUPERVISOR – HOSTEL
Stockholm, Sweden
We are looking for a hands-on Cleaning Supervisor to join our growing hostel group in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone with strong cleaning experience who is organized, responsible and enjoys working with people in an international environment.
Who we are looking for
Previous experience in professional cleaning and preferably as a cleaning supervisor or team leader.

Strong cleaning skills and a good understanding of cleanliness and hygiene standards.

Able to communicate confidently in English, both spoken and written.

Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.

Comfortable supervising and coordinating a small team.

Positive, practical and willing to take initiative.

EU citizenship or permanent residency/work authorization in an EU country.

Experience in hospitality, hostels or hotels is a plus, as is education within hospitality or service.

You do not need extensive hospitality or management experience to be considered. If you have strong cleaning experience, the right attitude and are willing to learn, we are happy to train you in the other parts of the role.
The role
As Cleaning Supervisor, you will both work hands-on with cleaning and supervise a small team. Your responsibilities include:
Cleaning guest rooms, bathrooms and common areas.

Supervising and coordinating the cleaning team.

Checking rooms and common areas to ensure our cleanliness standards are maintained.

Planning and distributing daily cleaning tasks.

Keeping track of cleaning supplies, linen and other necessities.

Helping with hostel reception and guest-related tasks when needed.

Reporting maintenance issues and helping solve practical day-to-day problems.

Communicating with the hostel management, online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel’s operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. You will have flexibility to organize your schedule according to the needs of the property.
About us
We are a growing hospitality company currently operating three hostels in central Stockholm. Our goal is to build an international hostel group based around our Scandinavian Nomad design concept.
Our organization combines on-site teams with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are opportunities to grow within the company and take on more responsibility over time.
What we offer
Salary: 27,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel
Vacation: One month paid vacation per year
You will work in a friendly, international environment, meet people from around the world and have the opportunity to develop your English, hospitality and leadership skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.

Description
Position at LeoVegas Group
ABOUT THE ROLE
Ready to build the technology that fuels our company's success behind the scenes? As a Senior JavaScript Engineer on our Back Office team, you'll play a key role in crafting a high impact platform using a modern tech stack: React, Node, GraphQL, and more. You'll collaborate closely with a talented team of designers and product experts to deliver intuitive, customer-centric products. This is a chance to join a highly collaborative team where you'll work closely with designers, product managers, and other engineers to deliver exceptional results.
 
YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
●  Implement modern, component-driven architecture using technologies such as React, Node, GraphQL, JSS, Jest, Relay, and TypeScript.
●  Collaborate closely with designers and product to build intuitive, customer-centric products.
●   Proactively identify architectural improvements and implement innovative solutions.
●   Actively contribute to team discussions, task creation, and delivery in a self-organized, agile environment.
●   Participate in peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentoring less senior developers to build a strong engineering culture.

 
OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:
ESSENTIAL SKILLS
 
●  5+ years in developing modern Web applications
●  You know JavaScript/TypeScript and React very well
●  You have worked with GraphQL
●  You can work in a highly collaborative and agile team
●   You are used to write Unit Tests
 
NICE TO HAVES
●   You have worked with Relay
●   You are familiar with and value Clean Code and Design patterns
 
 
 
WHO WE ARE
 
At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 1800 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 16 offices worldwide.

 
BENEFITS
●   Hybrid work policy
●   4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply)
●   30 annual vacation days
●   Occupational Pension
●    5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually
●    Parental Leave Top-Up

Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.
In the research subject Applied Geochemistry at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering, Luleå University of Technology (LTU), we are looking for a Postdoc Researcher. Applied Geochemistry at LTU focuses on the occurrence and mobility of elements and geochemical processes that occur in rock, soil, and water at the Earth’s surface. Research is conducted on natural and anthropogenic sources and their interactions within and between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, and biosphere. This is achieved by combining analytical chemistry, isotopic geochemistry, environmental forensics, and environmental mineralogy. Research and education in this subject address environmental issues tied to the mining industry, infrastructure construction, acid sulphate soils, and sulphide-bearing rocks. The research group has a strong experimental and applied profile, with well-equipped laboratories and extensive collaborations with industry and the public sector, all geared towards building a long-term, sustainable society.
Subject description
Applied Geochemistry is concerned with studies into the occurrence and mobility of the elements in rocks, soil, and water, focusing on methods to prevent or reduce the environmental impact of metal extraction and infrastructure development.
Background
The position will support the Swedish Research Council (Vetenskapsrådet) funded PhD Research School on Mining and Mineral Research – BioGeoMetals, a national collaboration between Linnaeus University (coordinator), Luleå University of Technology (LTU), and KTH Royal Institute of Technology. BioGeoMetals focuses on biogeochemical and hydrogeochemical approaches for sustainable metal recovery and environmental management in mining environments. The research school addresses the mobilization and recovery of critical raw materials from mining waste rock, tailings, groundwater, or run-off waters, as well as bioremediation of impacted mine sites. Through interdisciplinary doctoral training, joint courses, and close collaboration with industry and public authorities, the research school aims to educate the next generation of researchers contributing to sustainable mining and responsible resource management in Sweden and beyond.
Project description
The project will investigate how microbiology can be used in geochemical exploration to find ore deposits. Characterisation of solids, liquids and microbes in mining environments (e.g. tailings, mine water, and waste rock) will serve as the base for subsequent brown- and greenfield exploration trials. The successful candidate will focus on the characterisation of solids and closely work with the PhDs and partners in the project.
The work will cover:- Laboratory and field investigations- Mineralogical, geochemical and petrographic characterization- Development of analytical methods and exploration strategies
Duties
As a Postdoc, you will:
- Conduct field sampling of solid phases (rock, soil, till, sediments)
- Perform laboratory-based geochemical and mineralogical analyses
- Integrate and interpret multi-disciplinary datasets
- Design methods of mineral exploration
- Co-supervise PhD's
- Teach in geology-related courses
- Publish results in peer-reviewed scientific journals
- Present findings at national and international conferences
Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated candidate with a strong interest in exploration, geochemistry, field and laboratory work, microbiology, and sustainable mining.
You must have:
- A PhD degree in geology, geochemistry, environmental geoscience, or a closely related field
- Good oral and written proficiency in English
- Experience in conducting field work
- Expertise in soil-related exploration
- Strong background in characterisation techniques
- A driving license
Meritorious qualifications include:
- SEM-based automated mineralogy
- Heavy mineral concentration expertise
Personal qualities such as analytical ability, independence, collaboration skills, and strong motivation for research will be given significant weight.
Further information 
This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension. The position is based in Luleå. Start date: January 2027 or according to agreement.

jobs.occupation: Marketing Specialist - Life Science Content & Campaigns
jobs.description:
About the Job 
Join Symcel’s Sales and Marketing team as our new Marketing Specialist and help bring advanced instruments to researchers, laboratories and pharmaceutical manufacturers worldwide. 
We are looking for a creative, proactive and hands-on marketer with a strong life science background, excellent content creation skills and the ability to independently manage marketing projects from concept to completion. 
In this role, you will take ownership of content development, graphic design, video production, digital marketing activities, webinars and events, working closely with colleagues across Sales, Product Management and Applications. 
If you enjoy transforming complex scientific information into engaging, commercially relevant content and want to make a real impact in a growing international life science company, we'd love to hear from you. 

About Symcel 
Symcel is a Swedish life science company in an exciting commercial scale-up phase, with an international team of scientists, engineers and business professionals. 
Our innovative biocalorimetry-based systems use highly sensitive isothermal microcalorimetry to detect and analyze biological activity. Our instruments supports applications ranging from rapid sterility testing of advanced therapies and pharmaceuticals to microbial testing, biofilm analysis and biological research. 
We are united by a mission to support researchers and manufacturers develop, test and deliver life-changing treatments and products. 
Our company language is English. 
Discover more about us at symcel.com. 

Job description 
As a Marketing Specialist, you will plan, create and execute marketing activities across digital channels, scientific content, video, webinars and events. 
This is a hands-on role where you will independently manage projects from gathering scientific input and writing content to designing materials, publishing and distribution. 
You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Marketing, Product Management, Applications and Sales while taking ownership of your own projects and deliverables. 
The position is based at Symcel's head office on the Karolinska Institutet campus in Stockholm, with the option to work remotely 1–2 days per week. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Independently writing high-quality scientific and marketing content, including website copy, blog articles, case studies, brochures, presentations and sales materials. 
Designing and producing marketing materials, including brochures, advertisements, images, presentations and exhibition materials. 
Creating and editing video content, including product videos, interviews and short videos for digital channels and social media. 
Planning and producing webinars, including speaker coordination, recording, editing and promotion. 
Developing and managing digital marketing activities across channels such as social media, email, website and Google Ads. 
Managing and updating website content, ensuring SEO and AI search optimization, good user experience and alignment with brand guidelines. 
Coordinating Symcel’s participation in exhibitions and scientific conferences, including event planning, logistics and promotional materials. 

 
Qualifications 
We believe the ideal candidate combines a solid scientific understanding with strong communication skills, creative production capabilities and the ability to independently manage marketing activities. 

Required qualifications: 
Academic degree in life sciences, such as microbiology, biotechnology, biomedicine or a closely related discipline. 
At least 3 years of professional experience in marketing, content creation or scientific communication, including experience within the life science industry, diagnostics or laboratory instrumentation industries. 
Proven experience independently writing and producing high-quality scientific, technical and marketing content in English. 
Hands-on experience in graphic design and layout, with proficiency in tools such as Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Canva or equivalent. 
Hands-on experience creating and editing video content for marketing purposes. 
Experience working with digital marketing channels, including website content, email marketing and social media. 
Proven ability to translate complex scientific and technical information into engaging marketing content and independently manage projects from concept to final delivery. 
Excellent written and spoken English. 

Why join us? 
At Symcel, you’ll join a growing life science company with a collaborative, international and positive work environment. Our technology is helping improve solutions for medical treatments and patient care, enabling faster and more efficient quality control in areas such as cell and gene therapy. 
You’ll be part of an agile, engaged team where your contributions truly matter and where you’ll have the opportunity to grow, take initiative and help shape how we bring our solutions to the global market. 
 
Contact & Application 
We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis and are eager to fill this position. We encourage applications from candidates already based in the Stockholm region. 
To apply, please send your CV and cover letter to careers@symcel.com, using “Marketing Specialist” as the email subject line.

Please include examples or links to marketing materials you have personally created, demonstrating your experience in scientific content creation, graphic design and video production. 
 
Application deadline: 2027-01-10 
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner for a global company in Gothenburg (Mölndal). Start is December 16th, 5 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg (Mölndal).

Assignment description
Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner
﻿ 
Background:
Our client has established a Retail Sales Job Architecture and Skills Building Framework across its Personal Care and Consumer Tissue business areas. The framework provides a common capability foundation across four Sales Profiles: Commercial Management, Account Management, Field Sales and Sales Enablement.
﻿ 
The framework connects sales roles with functional and leadership skills, future capability requirements, onboarding, and ongoing development. The architecture, skills priorities, and strategic direction have already been defined. The objective of this assignment is not to redesign those foundations, but to translate them into a practical, scalable Retail Sales Academy with role- and skill-based learning journeys delivered through the company's Learning Experience Platform (LXP).
﻿ 
The LXP brings learning resources together in one place and enables employees to discover relevant learning opportunities, career paths, and development experiences aligned to their needs, interests, and goals.
﻿ 
The organization is seeking support to establish a practical and scalable Retail Sales Academy. The Academy will support approximately 1,500 employees across more than 20 markets. The focus is on implementing the existing framework and creating effective learning journeys rather than redefining capability models or long-term strategy.
Estimated project duration: 4–6 months
﻿ 
Overview and Need
English will serve as the master language for the Academy. However, the solution must be designed for successful deployment across Europe, North America, and Latin America, ensuring that language does not become a barrier to understanding, adoption, or application.
As a significant proportion of users are Spanish-speaking, it is important to accommodate local language requirements, particularly as many sales activities are conducted in local languages.
A key principle is to use and adapt existing learning content wherever possible before creating new content. Learning journeys should provide meaningful progression and connect learning with practical application, manager coaching, and peer learning rather than simply aggregating courses.
﻿ 
Responsibilities
- Define the Academy structure, learner navigation, and curriculum, including governance, ownership, and maintenance.
- Review existing learning content and map suitable assets to priority roles, skills, and proficiency levels.
- Design coherent learning journeys with clear learning outcomes, logical sequencing, practical application activities, and reinforcement mechanisms.
- Identify priority content gaps and selectively adapt or develop content where existing resources are insufficient.
- Define a scalable language and localization strategy using English as the master language and local-language content where needed.
- Prepare learning-path specifications, taxonomy structures, and metadata requirements for implementation in the Learning Experience Platform.
- Deliver documentation, editable assets, and knowledge-transfer materials to support long-term ownership and maintenance by the organization.
The consultant will work independently while collaborating closely with business stakeholders, SMEs, and learning teams.
﻿ 
Required Experience
The ideal consultant has strong experience in corporate academy design, curriculum architecture, and role- or skill-based learning journeys, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable learning solutions.
Relevant Experience
- Designing corporate academies, curricula, and role-based learning journeys aligned with business capabilities and proficiency levels.
- Assessing and curating large third-party learning libraries, selecting content based on relevance, quality, applicability, and business alignment.
- Working with Cornerstone or comparable enterprise learning platforms and content ecosystems.
- Applying a strong curate-before-create approach, maximizing existing content and minimizing unnecessary content development.
- Developing learning solutions for sales and commercial functions.
- Supporting learning initiatives across multiple countries and languages.
- Establishing quality-assurance and maintenance processes for localized learning assets.
- Integrating experiential learning, manager reinforcement, coaching, and practical application into learning journeys.
- Collaborating effectively with subject-matter experts and business stakeholders.
- Delivering implementation-ready outputs supported by structured documentation, handover, and knowledge transfer.
﻿ 
Key Success Factor
The most important capability is the ability to translate existing frameworks and learning resources into practical, relevant, scalable, and maintainable learning journeys rather than creating large volumes of new content.

This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is December 16th, 5 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg (Mölndal).

 Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.
